name_zh: 摩尔多瓦·斯特凡大公：抵抗奥斯曼与瓦拉几亚独立
name_en: Moldova Stephen the Great: Resistance Ottoman & Wallachia Independence
description_zh: 斯特凡三世 (1433-1504) 摩尔多瓦大公 (1457-1504)，抵抗奥斯曼帝国扩张48年，瓦西卢伊战役大捷，与瓦拉几亚弗拉德三世联盟抗奥，被教皇誉为基督教运动员，奠定摩尔多瓦国家认同基础。
description_en: Stephen III (1433-1504) Moldavia Voivode (1457-1504), resisted Ottoman expansion 48 years, Vaslui battle victory, allied with Wallachia Vlad III against Ottomans, praised by Pope as Athlete of Christ, founded Moldovan national identity basis.
reason_zh: 斯特凡大公代表东欧小国在奥斯曼扩张期的军事抵抗与外交生存智慧，展示了正教文明圈如何通过战略联盟与战术创新维护独立。
reason_en: Stephen the Great represents Eastern European small state military resistance and diplomatic survival wisdom during Ottoman expansion, demonstrating how Orthodox civilization sphere maintains independence through strategic alliances and tactical innovation.
steps_zh: 研究斯特凡早年流亡与匈牙利瓦拉几亚支持上位
分析1475瓦西卢伊战役战术创新与奥斯曼主力歼灭
探讨与弗拉德采佩什联盟抗奥与背叛博弈
评估1484奇利亚切蒂阿特拉失守与向奥斯曼称臣
总结斯特凡基督教运动员称号与摩尔多瓦民族英雄地位
steps_en: Study Stephen early exile and Hungarian Wallachian support for accession
Analyze 1475 Vaslui battle tactical innovation and Ottoman main force annihilation
Explore alliance with Vlad Tepes against Ottomans and betrayal game
Evaluate 1484 Chilia Cetatea Alba loss and Ottoman suzerainty acceptance
Summarize Stephen Athlete of Christ title and Moldovan national hero status
expected_zh: 掌握斯特凡大公军事抵抗与外交生存双重策略，理解东欧小国在奥斯曼阴影下的独立智慧，评估其对罗马尼亚摩尔多瓦共同民族认同的奠基作用。
expected_en: Master Stephen military resistance and diplomatic survival dual strategy, understand Eastern European small state independence wisdom under Ottoman shadow, evaluate its foundational role for Romanian Moldovan shared national identity.
case_zh: 1457 斯特凡即位；1475 瓦西卢伊大捷；1484 向奥斯曼称臣保留自治；1504 逝世葬于普特纳修道院。抵抗奥斯曼独立智慧永存。
case_en: 1457 Stephen accession; 1475 Vaslui victory; 1484 accepted Ottoman suzerainty retaining autonomy; 1504 died buried at Putna Monastery. Resistance Ottoman independence wisdom endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Ottoman resistance model; Moldovan national identity founder; Athlete of Christ
